checks.name: R4 source-identity compatibility
checks.evidence: Frozen R4->R3->R2 chain rejects generation-02 identity and the five-file overlay (see findings).

findings.detail: native_v4_source_binding() is frozen with base = 2cf0a6915ce544dc493a0990f2ea38d81601128a (r2:343). It requires manifest.groundtruth_commit, engine.native_reference.source_sha and runtime_source_overlay.base_source_sha all equal that base (r2:347-352), source_lock.native_commit equal that base (r2:354-356), and the runtime overlay to contain exactly the C26 model leaf (r2:364-365). Generation 02 has a06a72a as all four identities and a five-file overlay. R2 preserves this call at :486 inside native_rank_graph_evidence, R3 keeps it (edit at r3:237), R4 hash-pins R3 (r4:9-10) and executes it; the predicate is recorded as the rank_runtime_graph check (r2:1104) and any non-PASS check makes the run status FAIL (r2:775-781,1146).
findings.empirical: Executing only the hash-verified frozen function: real generation-02 identity -> ValueError "V4 runtime must declare the exact approved base2cf plus C26 source identity"; a coherent fake package with base identity and the real five-file overlay -> ValueError "V4 C26 is exactly one approved model file, not a general overlay".
findings.impact: A generation-02 run would fail R4 rank_runtime_graph and therefore the run verdict, regardless of runtime behavior. The recovery package cannot be accepted by the existing frozen checker as built.
findings.compatible_parts: The per-file source loop at r2:386-388 is compatible: all 75 non-model expected_source_hashes match the a06a72a checkout, and the model leaf keeps base c01be6d3 with approved overlay d3556a47. source_lock.harness_commit == f33306d4 matches the frozen harness. So only the identity constants and overlay-cardinality predicate conflict.
findings.requested_decision: Outside this review: either authorize a hash-pinned successor checker (R5) that admits the reviewed four-file startup overlay and the a06a72a identity, or record that R4 applies only to the generation-01 base+C26 reference and name the generation-02 acceptance oracle. design.md:95 already states the checker is not changed without approval.

minor_findings.detail: runtime_source_overlay.native_checkout_is_base_only remains true although the checkout now contains the approved startup correction. No consumer of this field was found in the frozen checkers or tests; it is a descriptive inaccuracy only.

The new base_sha256 values for the four startup files come from git 2cf0a69, not from the image. Bootstrap fails fast ("Installed base mismatch: <name>", native_dummy_bootstrap.py:56) before any import if the wheel differs, so a mismatch aborts startup safely but cannot be ruled out from this host.
